mapper.sql: select credential_id, schedule_id, target_id, credential_no, credential_token, qr_content, qr_code_url, credential_file_url, credential_image_url, issue_channel, scope_type, scope_ref_id, credential_name, active_core_credential_key, ability_json, credential_type, config_dimension, subject_type, subject_code, competition_series_id, competition_name, competition_stage_id, competition_stage_name, competition_track_id, competition_track_name, second_level_code, second_level_name, team_code, team_name, member_id, user_id, user_name, phone, email, id_card_type, id_card_hash, id_card_suffix, school, school_name, org_id, org_name, competition_role_name, leader_teacher_id, leader_teacher, guide_teacher, report_start_time, report_end_time, report_location, contest_start_time, contest_end_time, contest_location, contest_room, seat_no, waiting_start_time, waiting_end_time, waiting_location, waiting_group_code, waiting_group_name, material_location, notice, credential_snapshot_json, valid_from, valid_to, credential_status, verify_count, last_verify_time, report_status, report_time, report_operator_id, report_operator_name, material_status, material_time, material_receiver_name, material_receiver_phone, material_receiver_id_suffix, material_operator_id, material_operator_name, waiting_status, waiting_time, waiting_operator_id, waiting_operator_name, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, version, del_flag from competition_scene_credential

select csi.competition_id as competition_id, m.competition_series_id as competition_series_id, m.competition_name as competition_name, m.team_code as team_code, m.team_name as team_name, m.school_name as school_name, m.second_level_code as group_code, m.second_level_name as group_name, m.user_id as student_user_id, m.member_id as student_member_id, m.user_name as student_name, m.competition_role_name as role_code, m.competition_role_name as role_name, m.second_level_code as student_group_code, m.second_level_name as student_group_name, c.credential_id as credential_id, c.credential_name as credential_name, c.credential_no as credential_no, c.credential_type as credential_type, c.credential_status as credential_status, c.qr_content as qr_content, c.qr_code_url as qr_code_url, c.credential_file_url as credential_file_url, c.credential_image_url as credential_image_url, c.report_status as report_status, c.material_status as material_status, c.waiting_status as waiting_status, c.report_time as report_time, c.material_time as material_time, c.waiting_time as waiting_time, c.schedule_id as schedule_id, s.schedule_name as schedule_name, c.contest_location as contest_location, c.contest_room as contest_room, c.contest_start_time as schedule_start_time, c.contest_end_time as schedule_end_time, c.scope_type as scope_type, c.scope_ref_id as scope_ref_id, c.subject_type as subject_type, c.subject_code as subject_code, c.config_dimension as config_dimension
mapper.select: where target_id = #{targetId} and del_flag = '0' and credential_status = 'EFFECTIVE' order by credential_id desc limit 1
where competition_series_id = #{competitionSeriesId} and scope_type = 'COMPETITION' and user_id = #{userId} and credential_status = 'EFFECTIVE' and del_flag = '0' order by credential_id desc limit 1
select count(1) from competition_scene_credential where schedule_id = #{scheduleId} and del_flag = '0'

select ifnull(max(cast(substring_index(credential_no, '-', -1) as unsigned)), 0) from competition_scene_credential where schedule_id = #{scheduleId} and credential_no like concat(#{credentialNoPrefix}, '%') and substring_index(credential_no, '-', -1) regexp '^[0-9]+$'

from competition_apply_info m left join competition_series_info csi on m.competition_series_id = csi.competition_series_id left join competition_scene_credential c on c.del_flag = '0' and c.competition_series_id = m.competition_series_id and ( (c.subject_type = 'TEAM' and c.team_code collate utf8mb4_general_ci = m.team_code collate utf8mb4_general_ci) or ( (c.subject_type is null or c.subject_type != 'TEAM') and ( (c.member_id is not null and c.member_id = m.member_id) or (c.user_id is not null and c.user_id = m.user_id) ) ) ) left join competition_scene_schedule s on s.schedule_id = c.schedule_id and s.del_flag = '0'
m.del_flag = '0' and m.pay_status = 'paid' and (m.check_status = '4' or m.check_status is null or m.check_status = '') and (m.competition_role_name is null or m.competition_role_name not in ('指导教师', '指导老师')) and
and csi.competition_id = #{query.competitionId}
and m.competition_series_id = #{query.competitionSeriesId}
and m.team_code collate utf8mb4_general_ci = convert(#{query.teamCode} using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci
and ( m.user_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci like concat('%', convert(#{query.keyword} using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci, '%') or m.team_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci like concat('%', convert(#{query.keyword} using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci, '%') or m.team_code collate utf8mb4_general_ci like concat('%', convert(#{query.keyword} using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci, '%') or m.competition_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci like concat('%', convert(#{query.keyword} using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci, '%') or c.credential_no collate utf8mb4_general_ci like concat('%', convert(#{query.keyword} using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci, '%') or s.schedule_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci like concat('%', convert(#{query.keyword} using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci, '%') )
order by m.competition_series_id desc, m.team_code asc, case when m.team_sort is null then 1 else 0 end, m.team_sort asc, m.member_id asc, case when c.credential_id is null then 1 else 0 end, c.contest_start_time asc, c.credential_id desc

from competition_apply_info m left join competition_series_info csi on m.competition_series_id = csi.competition_series_id inner join competition_scene_credential c on c.credential_id = #{credentialId} and c.del_flag = '0' and c.competition_series_id = m.competition_series_id and ( (c.subject_type = 'TEAM' and c.team_code collate utf8mb4_general_ci = m.team_code collate utf8mb4_general_ci) or ( (c.subject_type is null or c.subject_type != 'TEAM') and ( (c.member_id is not null and c.member_id = m.member_id) or (c.user_id is not null and c.user_id = m.user_id) ) ) ) left join competition_scene_schedule s on s.schedule_id = c.schedule_id and s.del_flag = '0'
m.del_flag = '0' and m.pay_status = 'paid' and (m.check_status = '4' or m.check_status is null or m.check_status = '') and (m.competition_role_name is null or m.competition_role_name not in ('指导教师', '指导老师')) and
order by case when m.team_sort is null then 1 else 0 end, m.team_sort asc, m.member_id asc limit 1

update competition_scene_credential
qr_code_url = #{qrCodeUrl}, credential_file_url = #{credentialFileUrl}, credential_image_url = #{credentialImageUrl}, issue_channel = #{issueChannel}, scope_type = #{scopeType}, scope_ref_id = #{scopeRefId}, active_core_credential_key = #{activeCoreCredentialKey}, credential_name = #{credentialName}, ability_json = #{abilityJson}, subject_code = #{subjectCode}, credential_status = #{credentialStatus}, active_core_credential_key = null, verify_count = #{verifyCount}, last_verify_time = #{lastVerifyTime}, report_status = #{reportStatus}, report_time = #{reportTime}, report_operator_id = #{reportOperatorId}, report_operator_name = #{reportOperatorName}, material_status = #{materialStatus}, material_time = #{materialTime}, material_receiver_name = #{materialReceiverName}, material_receiver_phone = #{materialReceiverPhone}, material_receiver_id_suffix = #{materialReceiverIdSuffix}, material_operator_id = #{materialOperatorId}, material_operator_name = #{materialOperatorName}, waiting_status = #{waitingStatus}, waiting_time = #{waitingTime}, waiting_operator_id = #{waitingOperatorId}, waiting_operator_name = #{waitingOperatorName}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime}, remark = #{remark}, version = version + 1,
where credential_id = #{credentialId} and del_flag = '0'

update competition_scene_credential
report_status = '0', report_time = null, report_operator_id = null, report_operator_name = null,
material_status = '0', material_time = null, material_receiver_name = null, material_receiver_phone = null, material_receiver_id_suffix = null, material_operator_id = null, material_operator_name = null,
waiting_status = '0', waiting_time = null, waiting_operator_id = null, waiting_operator_name = null,
update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now(), version = version + 1
where credential_id = #{credentialId} and del_flag = '0'

update competition_scene_credential set credential_status = 'REVOKED', active_core_credential_key = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now(), version = version + 1 where target_id = #{targetId} and credential_status = 'EFFECTIVE' and del_flag = '0'

update competition_scene_credential set verify_count = ifnull(verify_count, 0) + 1, last_verify_time = #{lastVerifyTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime}, version = version + 1 where credential_id = #{credentialId} and del_flag = '0'
